dedupe_keys.name: spatial distribution and environmental attributes dataset of china s large scale data centers in 2024

description: Hefei University of Technology researchers publish locations and environmental attributes of large-scale data centres across China for a 2024 baseline. The Science Data Bank deposit separates verified locations assembled from points of interest, Random Forest probability surfaces and representative satellite rooftop images for each province. Attributes include longitude, latitude, temperature, precipitation, elevation and operational type; the provider states WGS84/UTM Zone 50N as the shared spatial reference. Version 4 was updated on 8 May 2026. The public page reports one 85.03 GB deposited file under CC BY 4.0, permitting free reuse, but its inspected metadata does not specify internal file formats or a uniform grid resolution. GitHub documents a Python and Google Earth Engine preparation workflow; its code licence is not stated. Probability surfaces must not be treated as confirmed facility locations. The resource can support site-suitability, hazard-exposure and data-centre energy-demand scenarios after suitable capacity assumptions are supplied. It complements data-china-national-green-data-centre-list, which identifies officially recognised facilities, not this spatial inference product.
